deck: Nifty closed at 25,801 (▲ 1.12%) and Sensex at 83,920 (▲ 1.08%). Over the last five sessions Nifty is up 2.6%. Brent crude is near $90 a barrel and the rupee at 92.67 to the dollar.
story: Of the 80 large stocks this page tracks, 52 rose and 28 fell. INDUSINDBK led the gainers (+8.59%), while VEDL fell the most (-2.32%). Bank Nifty ended ▲ 2.49%.
Across markets: Brent crude near $90 a barrel (-3.4% on the week), the rupee at 92.67 per dollar (stronger on the week), gold near $3,515 an ounce.

In the headlines: “Nifty, Sensex Extend Gains For 4th Week Amid Strong Foreign Inflows” (Ommcom News). “Crude oil prices to fall to $70 by 2027? Why global oil market may see a major surplus” (The Financial Express).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 3.4% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 92.67 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
